</Fact>

facts.name: Commonwealth Savers, last birth date for the no-cap rule
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to the $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 has attained 70 during tax year 2024.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCommonwealthSaversAge70BirthDateCutoff">
  <Name>Commonwealth Savers, last birth date for the no-cap rule</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to
        the $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 has attained 70 during tax year 2024.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Day>1954-12-31</Day>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Not barred from the low-income credits outright
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1) and the 2024 Schedule ADJ eligibility requirements: no credit for a filer claimed as a dependent on another return. The other bars (the age deduction, the 65 or older and blind exemptions, military basic pay, claimed by the filer or the spouse) are elections, weighed in /vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit. The National Guard and federal and state employee subtractions (codes 28 and 39) are out of scope, as is anything a dependent claims.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCanClaimLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Not barred from the low-income credits outright</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1) and the 2024 Schedule ADJ eligibility requirements: no
        credit for a filer claimed as a dependent on another return. The other bars (the age
        deduction, the 65 or older and blind exemptions, military basic pay, claimed by the filer or
        the spouse) are elections, weighed in /vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit. The National Guard and
        federal and state employee subtractions (codes 28 and 39) are out of scope, as is anything a
        dependent claims.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Not>
      <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/canBeClaimed"/>
    </Not>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 11, poverty guideline for the family size
facts.description: 2024 Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one, plus $5,380 for each more person. Family size is the You, Spouse and Dependents count (/vaPersonalExemptionCount).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPovertyGuideline">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 11, poverty guideline for the family size</Name>
  <Description>2024 Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one, plus $5,380 for each more person.
        Family size is the You, Spouse and Dependents count (/vaPersonalExemptionCount).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPovertyGuidelineFirstPerson"/>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPovertyGuidelineEachAdditionalPerson"/>
        <Subtract>
          <Minuend>
            <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
          </Minuend>
          <Subtrahends>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Subtrahends>
        </Subtract>
      </Multiply>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Family VAGI at or under the poverty guideline
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1). Family VAGI (Schedule ADJ Line 10) is the return's Virginia AGI with no age deduction or basic pay subtraction; a dependent's own income is not on the federal return, so it is taken as $0 here.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaQualifiesForCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Family VAGI at or under the poverty guideline</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1). Family VAGI (Schedule ADJ Line 10) is the return's
        Virginia AGI with no age deduction or basic pay subtraction; a dependent's own income is not
        on the federal return, so it is taken as $0 here.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaCanClaimLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <LessThanOrEqual>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaWithCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency path="/vaPovertyGuideline"/>
        </Right>
      </LessThanOrEqual>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 13, Credit for Low-Income Individuals
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 times the personal and dependent exemptions (Schedule ADJ Line 12; not the 65 or older or blind ones), if the family qualifies.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 13, Credit for Low-Income Individuals</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 times the personal and dependent exemptions
        (Schedule ADJ Line 12; not the 65 or older or blind ones), if the family qualifies.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaQualifiesForCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaLowIncomeCreditPerExemption"/>
            <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 14, federal earned income credit
facts.description: Read from the federal return (/earnedIncomeCredit, exported to MeF as Form 1040 line 27). $0 for a filer claimed as a dependent.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaFederalEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 14, federal earned income credit</Name>
  <Description>Read from the federal return (/earnedIncomeCredit, exported to MeF as Form 1040
        line 27). $0 for a filer claimed as a dependent.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaCanClaimLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="eitc" path="/earnedIncomeCredit"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 15, Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(2): 20% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 15, Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(2): 20% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaEarnedIncomeCreditRate"/>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
      </Multiply>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 16a, the greater of Line 13 or Line 15
facts.description: Schedule ADJ Line 16a: the greater of Line 13 (the Credit for Low-Income Individuals) and Line 15 (the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit), § 58.1-339.8; the schedule claims one, not both.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaGreaterNonrefundableCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 16a, the greater of Line 13 or Line 15</Name>
  <Description>Schedule ADJ Line 16a: the greater of Line 13 (the Credit for Low-Income Individuals) and Line 15 (the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit), § 58.1-339.8; the schedule claims one, not both.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dependency path="/vaCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 16b, Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): 15% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 16b, Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(3)(a): 15% of Line 14, rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCreditRate"/>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
      </Multiply>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 16a, limited to the tax
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(C): a nonrefundable credit cannot exceed the tax (Line 18, here the tax on the return that claims the credit).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaNonrefundableCreditUsable">
  <Name>Line 16a, limited to the tax</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(C): a nonrefundable credit cannot exceed the tax (Line 18,
        here the tax on the return that claims the credit).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <LesserOf>
      <Dependency path="/vaGreaterNonrefundableCredit"/>
      <Dependency module="virginiaTax" path="/vaWithCreditTax"/>
    </LesserOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: The refundable credit is worth more than the nonrefundable one
facts.description: 2024 Schedule ADJ Line 17: "Choose the credit option that benefits you the most."
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditIsRefundable">
  <Name>The refundable credit is worth more than the nonrefundable one</Name>
  <Description>2024 Schedule ADJ Line 17: "Choose the credit option that benefits you the most."</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterThan>
      <Left>
        <Dependency path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Dependency path="/vaNonrefundableCreditUsable"/>
      </Right>
    </GreaterThan>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 17, the credit that benefits the filer most
facts.description: The lesser of Line 16a and the tax, or Line 16b, whichever is greater.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 17, the credit that benefits the filer most</Name>
  <Description>The lesser of Line 16a and the tax, or Line 16b, whichever is greater.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dependency path="/vaNonrefundableCreditUsable"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Tax less the credit, if the return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: Negative when the refundable credit exceeds the tax.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithCreditTaxAfterCredit">
  <Name>Tax less the credit, if the return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>Negative when the refundable credit exceeds the tax.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Subtract>
      <Minuend>
        <Dependency module="virginiaTax" path="/vaWithCreditTax"/>
      </Minuend>
      <Subtrahends>
        <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
      </Subtrahends>
    </Subtract>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: The return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: The election Form 760 leaves to the filer: the instructions for Line 4 say to "claim the deduction or subtraction that gives you the greatest tax benefit." The return claims a credit when there is one and the tax less the credit is lower than the tax keeping everything Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D) says the filer, the spouse or both would give up: the age deduction of either spouse, the 65 or older and blind exemptions of either spouse, and the military basic pay subtraction. Withholding, payments and use tax are the same either way, so this is the whole comparison.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>The return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>The election Form 760 leaves to the filer: the instructions for Line 4 say to
        "claim the deduction or subtraction that gives you the greatest tax benefit." The return
        claims a credit when there is one and the tax less the credit is lower than the tax keeping
        everything Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D) says the filer, the spouse or both would give up: the age
        deduction of either spouse, the 65 or older and blind exemptions of either spouse, and the
        military basic pay subtraction. Withholding, payments and use tax are the same either way, so
        this is the whole comparison.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
      <LessThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTaxAfterCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency module="virginiaTax" path="/vaWithoutCreditTax"/>
        </Right>
      </LessThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 23, Credit for Low-Income Individuals or Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Schedule ADJ Line 17 when the return claims it; otherwise $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 23, Credit for Low-Income Individuals or Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Schedule ADJ Line 17 when the return claims it; otherwise $0.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 23 is the Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Which credit Line 23 is, for the summary's words: the refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit (Schedule ADJ Line 16b, § 58.1-339.8), when the return claims a low-income credit and /vaCreditIsRefundable chose the refundable one.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsRefundableEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Line 23 is the Refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Which credit Line 23 is, for the summary's words: the refundable Virginia Earned Income Credit (Schedule ADJ Line 16b, § 58.1-339.8), when the return claims a low-income credit and /vaCreditIsRefundable chose the refundable one.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaCreditIsRefundable"/>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 23 is the Credit for Low-Income Individuals
facts.description: Line 16a is Line 13 when Line 13 is at least Line 15.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Line 23 is the Credit for Low-Income Individuals</Name>
  <Description>Line 16a is Line 13 when Line 13 is at least Line 15.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaCreditIsRefundable"/>
      </Not>
      <GreaterThanOrEqual>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency path="/vaEarnedIncomeCredit"/>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThanOrEqual>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 23 is the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit
facts.description: Which credit Line 23 is, for the summary's words: the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit (Schedule ADJ Line 15, § 58.1-339.8), when the return claims a low-income credit, the refundable one is not worth more, and Line 15 beats Line 13.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsNonrefundableEarnedIncomeCredit">
  <Name>Line 23 is the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit</Name>
  <Description>Which credit Line 23 is, for the summary's words: the nonrefundable Virginia Earned Income Credit (Schedule ADJ Line 15, § 58.1-339.8), when the return claims a low-income credit, the refundable one is not worth more, and Line 15 beats Line 13.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaCreditIsRefundable"/>
      </Not>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaClaimsCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
      </Not>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Claiming the credit gave up the age deduction
facts.description: Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's deduction.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditReplacedAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Claiming the credit gave up the age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was
        worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's deduction.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Claiming the credit gave up the 65 or older or blind exemptions
facts.description: Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's boxes.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditReplacedAgedOrBlindExemptions">
  <Name>Claiming the credit gave up the 65 or older or blind exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was
        worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's boxes.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionsAllowed"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Claiming the credit gave up the military basic pay subtraction
facts.description: Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was worth.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditReplacedMilitaryBasicPay">
  <Name>Claiming the credit gave up the military basic pay subtraction</Name>
  <Description>Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was worth.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtractionAllowed"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: A credit was available, but keeping the deductions saves more
facts.description: For the summary: a low-income credit was available (Schedule ADJ Line 17 above zero) but the return keeps the age deduction, the 65-or-older and blind exemptions and the military basic pay subtraction the credit would bar (§ 58.1-339.8(D)), because they save more. Computes no line.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditDeclinedForADeduction">
  <Name>A credit was available, but keeping the deductions saves more</Name>
  <Description>For the summary: a low-income credit was available (Schedule ADJ Line 17 above zero) but the return keeps the age deduction, the 65-or-older and blind exemptions and the military basic pay subtraction the credit would bar (§ 58.1-339.8(D)), because they save more. Computes no line.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      </Not>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Standard deduction amount for this filing status
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b). Federal itemizers must itemize in Virginia (Line 10); that case is out of scope, so every return here takes the standard deduction.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaStandardDeductionForFilingStatus">
  <Name>Standard deduction amount for this filing status</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b). Federal itemizers must itemize in Virginia (Line
        10); that case is out of scope, so every return here takes the standard deduction.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaStandardDeductionMarried"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaStandardDeductionSingle"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 11, standard deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): a person who can be claimed as a dependent on another's return takes the deduction only with respect to earned income; 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11, "Dependent on Another's Return": the smaller of earned income and the standard deduction. Earned income here is W-2 wages (/wages, exported to MeF).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaStandardDeduction">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 11, standard deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): a person who can be claimed as a dependent on
        another's return takes the deduction only with respect to earned income; 2024 Form 760
        instructions, Line 11, "Dependent on Another's Return": the smaller of earned income and
        the standard deduction. Earned income here is W-2 wages (/wages, exported to MeF).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/canBeClaimed"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/vaStandardDeductionForFilingStatus"/>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaStandardDeductionForFilingStatus"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions claimed in the You, Spouse and Dependents boxes
facts.description: 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section A: yourself, your spouse on a joint return, and the dependents claimed federally, counted from each household member's isClaimedDependent, which the federal return exports to states. (The federal /claimedDependentsCount is not exported, so it is not read.)
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount">
  <Name>Exemptions claimed in the You, Spouse and Dependents boxes</Name>
  <Description>2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section A: yourself, your spouse on a
        joint return, and the dependents claimed federally, counted from each household member's
        isClaimedDependent, which the federal return exports to states. (The federal
        /claimedDependentsCount is not exported, so it is not read.)</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Int>1</Int>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Count>
        <Dependency module="familyAndHousehold" path="/familyAndHousehold/*/isClaimedDependent"/>
      </Count>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions claimed in the 65 or older and Blind boxes
facts.description: 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section B, four boxes: you 65 or older on or before January 1, 2025 (the federal /age65OrOlder rule), you blind for federal purposes, and on a joint return the same two for your spouse.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionCount">
  <Name>Exemptions claimed in the 65 or older and Blind boxes</Name>
  <Description>2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section B, four boxes: you 65 or older on or
        before January 1, 2025 (the federal /age65OrOlder rule), you blind for federal purposes, and
        on a joint return the same two for your spouse.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/age65OrOlder"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/isBlind"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseAge65OrOlder"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseIsBlind"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions, Section A amount
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(a): $930 times the You, Spouse and Dependents count.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPersonalExemptions">
  <Name>Exemptions, Section A amount</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(a): $930 times the You, Spouse and Dependents count.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPersonalExemptionAmount"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions, Section B amount the filers qualify for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 times the 65 or older and Blind count, the spouse's boxes included. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions: these cannot be claimed with a Credit for Low-Income Individuals on Line 23 (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(4) bars every low-income credit when the filer or the spouse claims one).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionsAllowed">
  <Name>Exemptions, Section B amount the filers qualify for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 times the 65 or older and Blind count, the
        spouse's boxes included. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions: these cannot be claimed with
        a Credit for Low-Income Individuals on Line 23 (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(4) bars every
        low-income credit when the filer or the spouse claims one).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionAmount"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionCount"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 12 if the return keeps the 65 or older and blind exemptions
facts.description: Line 12 as it stands when no low-income credit is claimed: the personal exemptions plus the 65-or-older and blind exemptions, § 58.1-322.03(2). The credits module's switch picks this or the personal exemptions alone.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditExemptions">
  <Name>Line 12 if the return keeps the 65 or older and blind exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Line 12 as it stands when no low-income credit is claimed: the personal exemptions plus the 65-or-older and blind exemptions, § 58.1-322.03(2). The credits module's switch picks this or the personal exemptions alone.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptions"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionsAllowed"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 12, exemptions
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2): Section A plus Section B, or Section A alone when the return claims a low-income credit.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaExemptions">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 12, exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2): Section A plus Section B, or Section A alone when the
        return claims a low-income credit.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditExemptions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 14 if the return keeps the 65 or older and blind exemptions
facts.description: Line 14 as it stands when no low-income credit is claimed: the standard deduction, both kinds of exemption and the Commonwealth Savers deduction. /vaTotalDeductions picks this or /vaWithCreditTotalDeductions.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalDeductions">
  <Name>Line 14 if the return keeps the 65 or older and blind exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Line 14 as it stands when no low-income credit is claimed: the standard deduction, both kinds of exemption and the Commonwealth Savers deduction. /vaTotalDeductions picks this or /vaWithCreditTotalDeductions.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaStandardDeduction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditExemptions"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaCommonwealthSaversDeduction"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 14 if the return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: Line 14 as it stands when a low-income credit is claimed: the standard deduction, the personal exemptions alone (the credit bars the 65-or-older and blind exemptions, § 58.1-339.8(D)) and the Commonwealth Savers deduction.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithCreditTotalDeductions">
  <Name>Line 14 if the return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>Line 14 as it stands when a low-income credit is claimed: the standard deduction, the personal exemptions alone (the credit bars the 65-or-older and blind exemptions, § 58.1-339.8(D)) and the Commonwealth Savers deduction.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaStandardDeduction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptions"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaCommonwealthSaversDeduction"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 14, total deductions
facts.description: Lines 10 + 11 + 12 + 13, whichever way the return files. Line 10 (itemized) and the Schedule ADJ deductions other than Commonwealth Savers are out of scope and taken as $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaTotalDeductions">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 14, total deductions</Name>
  <Description>Lines 10 + 11 + 12 + 13, whichever way the return files. Line 10 (itemized) and
        the Schedule ADJ deductions other than Commonwealth Savers are out of scope and taken as $0.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTotalDeductions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalDeductions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 15 if the return keeps the age deduction and exemptions
facts.description: Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome">
  <Name>Line 15 if the return keeps the age deduction and exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaWithoutCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalDeductions"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 15 if the return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithCreditTaxableIncome">
  <Name>Line 15 if the return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaWithCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTotalDeductions"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 15, Virginia taxable income
facts.description: Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaTaxableIncome">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 15, Virginia taxable income</Name>
  <Description>Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTaxableIncome"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Contributed to a Commonwealth Savers (Virginia529) account in 2024
facts.description: Asked, because the plan reports nothing to the IRS. Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaHasCommonwealthSaversContributions">
  <Name>Contributed to a Commonwealth Savers (Virginia529) account in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Asked, because the plan reports nothing to the IRS. Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7).</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Boolean/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

facts.name: Amount contributed to Commonwealth Savers accounts in 2024
facts.description: The total paid or contributed in the year, before the per-account cap.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCommonwealthSaversContributions">
  <Name>Amount contributed to Commonwealth Savers accounts in 2024</Name>
  <Description>The total paid or contributed in the year, before the per-account cap.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Dollar/>
  </Writable>
  <Placeholder>
    <Dollar>0</Dollar>
  </Placeholder>
</Fact>

facts.name: Primary filer has attained age 70
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to the $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 for tax year 2024 (/vaCommonwealthSaversAge70BirthDateCutoff). Reads the exported date of birth. The contributions are asked of the primary filer only, so the spouse's age does not enter.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerAge70OrOlder">
  <Name>Primary filer has attained age 70</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to the
        $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 for tax year 2024
        (/vaCommonwealthSaversAge70BirthDateCutoff). Reads the exported date of birth. The
        contributions are asked of the primary filer only, so the spouse's age does not enter.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <LessThanOrEqual>
      <Left>
        <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/dateOfBirth"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaCommonwealthSaversAge70BirthDateCutoff"/>
      </Right>
    </LessThanOrEqual>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 13 (Schedule ADJ), Commonwealth Savers deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7): the contribution, capped at $4,000 unless the filer has attained age 70. The other Schedule ADJ deductions are out of scope.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCommonwealthSaversDeduction">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 13 (Schedule ADJ), Commonwealth Savers deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7): the contribution, capped at $4,000 unless the filer has
        attained age 70. The other Schedule ADJ deductions are out of scope.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasCommonwealthSaversContributions"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerAge70OrOlder"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaCommonwealthSaversContributions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaCommonwealthSaversCap"/>
            <Dependency path="/vaCommonwealthSaversContributions"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia resident
facts.description: The filer lived in Virginia for all of the tax year, as answered on the federal residence question (/filerResidenceAndIncomeState, with 'va' added to the federal /scopedStateOptions). Part-year and nonresident returns (Forms 760PY and 763) are out of scope. This fact gates the Virginia screens; it is not an export.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaIsResident">
  <Name>Virginia resident</Name>
  <Description>The filer lived in Virginia for all of the tax year, as answered on the federal
        residence question (/filerResidenceAndIncomeState, with 'va' added to the federal
        /scopedStateOptions). Part-year and nonresident returns (Forms 760PY and 763) are out of
        scope. This fact gates the Virginia screens; it is not an export.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Equal>
      <Left>
        <Dependency module="filers" path="/filerResidenceAndIncomeState"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Enum optionsPath="/scopedStateOptions">va</Enum>
      </Right>
    </Equal>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia Filing Status 2, married filing jointly
facts.description: Form 760 Filing Status 2 corresponds to a federal joint return. Federal single and head of household file as Filing Status 1; married filing separately as Status 3. Qualifying surviving spouse is out of scope and treated as Status 1 here.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaIsFilingStatus2">
  <Name>Virginia Filing Status 2, married filing jointly</Name>
  <Description>Form 760 Filing Status 2 corresponds to a federal joint return. Federal single
        and head of household file as Filing Status 1; married filing separately as Status 3.
        Qualifying surviving spouse is out of scope and treated as Status 1 here.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Equal>
      <Left>
        <Dependency module="filingStatus" path="/filingStatus"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">marriedFilingJointly</Enum>
      </Right>
    </Equal>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: This filer is the spouse
facts.description: Not the primary filer. The federal return exports each filer's /filers/*/isPrimaryFiler to states; the federal /filers/*/isSecondaryFiler and the /secondaryFiler pointer are not exported, so the spouse is found from the flag a state is handed.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/filers/*/vaIsSpouse">
  <Name>This filer is the spouse</Name>
  <Description>Not the primary filer. The federal return exports each filer's
        /filers/*/isPrimaryFiler to states; the federal /filers/*/isSecondaryFiler and the
        /secondaryFiler pointer are not exported, so the spouse is found from the flag a state is
        handed.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Not>
      <Dependency module="filers" path="../isPrimaryFiler"/>
    </Not>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: The spouse on a joint return
facts.description: The filer who is not the primary filer: how a state's software finds the spouse in what it is handed. Read only on Filing Status 2; the facts below guard that.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouse">
  <Name>The spouse on a joint return</Name>
  <Description>The filer who is not the primary filer: how a state's software finds the spouse in
        what it is handed. Read only on Filing Status 2; the facts below guard that.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Find path="/filers">
      <Dependency path="vaIsSpouse"/>
    </Find>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Spouse 65 or older
facts.description: On a joint return, the spouse's federal /age65OrOlder (65 on or before January 1, 2025, the rule Virginia's Section B uses). False on any other filing status. A joint return always carries the spouse's date of birth, so the completeness guard only keeps a return with no spouse facts from going incomplete.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseAge65OrOlder">
  <Name>Spouse 65 or older</Name>
  <Description>On a joint return, the spouse's federal /age65OrOlder (65 on or before January 1,
        2025, the rule Virginia's Section B uses). False on any other filing status. A joint return
        always carries the spouse's date of birth, so the completeness guard only keeps a return with
        no spouse facts from going incomplete.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <All>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/age65OrOlder"/>
            </IsComplete>
            <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/age65OrOlder"/>
          </All>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <False/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Spouse blind
facts.description: On a joint return, the spouse's federal /isBlind (blind for federal purposes, IRC § 63(f)). False on any other filing status.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseIsBlind">
  <Name>Spouse blind</Name>
  <Description>On a joint return, the spouse's federal /isBlind (blind for federal purposes, IRC
        § 63(f)). False on any other filing status.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <All>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/isBlind"/>
            </IsComplete>
            <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/isBlind"/>
          </All>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <False/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Spouse born on or before January 1, 1939
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a), for the spouse on a joint return: the full $12,000 age deduction regardless of income. Reads the spouse's exported date of birth.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseBornOnOrBefore1939">
  <Name>Spouse born on or before January 1, 1939</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a), for the spouse on a joint return: the full $12,000 age
        deduction regardless of income. Reads the spouse's exported date of birth.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <All>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/dateOfBirth"/>
            </IsComplete>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/dateOfBirth"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionFullAmountBirthDateCutoff"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </All>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <False/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 1, federal adjusted gross income
facts.description: Read from the federal return (/agi, exported to MeF as Form 1040 line 11). Line 2 (additions) is out of scope, so Line 3 equals Line 1.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaFederalAdjustedGrossIncome">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 1, federal adjusted gross income</Name>
  <Description>Read from the federal return (/agi, exported to MeF as Form 1040 line 11).
        Line 2 (additions) is out of scope, so Line 3 equals Line 1.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Dependency module="taxCalculations" path="/agi"/>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 5, taxable Social Security benefits
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(3): benefits under Title II of the Social Security Act included in federal AGI are subtracted. Read from the federal return (Form 1040 line 6b).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaTaxableSocialSecurityBenefits">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 5, taxable Social Security benefits</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(3): benefits under Title II of the Social Security Act
        included in federal AGI are subtracted. Read from the federal return (Form 1040 line
        6b).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Dependency module="socialSecurity" path="/taxableSocialSecurityBenefits"/>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Adjusted federal adjusted gross income (AFAGI)
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): federal AGI minus Social Security Title II benefits and other benefits taxable solely under IRC § 86. Used only for the age deduction's income test; on a joint return it is the joint figure. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Age Deduction Worksheet lines 2 to 8 (the conformity addition and subtraction on worksheet lines 3 and 5 are out of scope).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAdjustedFederalAdjustedGrossIncome">
  <Name>Adjusted federal adjusted gross income (AFAGI)</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): federal AGI minus Social Security Title II benefits
        and other benefits taxable solely under IRC § 86. Used only for the age deduction's
        income test; on a joint return it is the joint figure. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Age
        Deduction Worksheet lines 2 to 8 (the conformity addition and subtraction on worksheet
        lines 3 and 5 are out of scope).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Subtract>
      <Minuend>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
      </Minuend>
      <Subtrahends>
        <Dependency path="/vaTaxableSocialSecurityBenefits"/>
      </Subtrahends>
    </Subtract>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Primary filer born on or before January 1, 1939
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a): the full $12,000 age deduction regardless of income. Reads the filer's date of birth, which the federal return exports to states.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerBornOnOrBefore1939">
  <Name>Primary filer born on or before January 1, 1939</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a): the full $12,000 age deduction regardless of
        income. Reads the filer's date of birth, which the federal return exports to
        states.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <LessThanOrEqual>
      <Left>
        <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/dateOfBirth"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionFullAmountBirthDateCutoff"/>
      </Right>
    </LessThanOrEqual>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Primary filer qualifies for the income-based age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): born after January 1, 1939, and 65 or older. The federal /age65OrOlder uses the same rule as Virginia's instructions (65 on or before January 1 of the following year), so for tax year 2024 it means born on or before January 1, 1960.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerQualifiesForIncomeBasedAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Primary filer qualifies for the income-based age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): born after January 1, 1939, and 65 or older. The
        federal /age65OrOlder uses the same rule as Virginia's instructions (65 on or before
        January 1 of the following year), so for tax year 2024 it means born on or before
        January 1, 1960.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/age65OrOlder"/>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerBornOnOrBefore1939"/>
      </Not>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Spouse qualifies for the income-based age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b), for the spouse on a joint return: born after January 1, 1939, and 65 or older.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseQualifiesForIncomeBasedAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Spouse qualifies for the income-based age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b), for the spouse on a joint return: born after
        January 1, 1939, and 65 or older.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseAge65OrOlder"/>
      <Not>
        <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseBornOnOrBefore1939"/>
      </Not>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction income threshold for this return
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThreshold">
  <Name>Age deduction income threshold for this return</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): $50,000 single, $75,000 married.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThresholdMarried"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThresholdSingle"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction reduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): $1 for each $1 of AFAGI over the threshold, never below zero. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Age Deduction Worksheet line 11. One figure for the return; on a joint return it applies to each spouse's $12,000.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionReduction">
  <Name>Age deduction reduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): $1 for each $1 of AFAGI over the threshold, never
        below zero. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Age Deduction Worksheet line 11. One figure for the
        return; on a joint return it applies to each spouse's $12,000.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency path="/vaAdjustedFederalAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThreshold"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction the primary filer qualifies for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older, $12,000 reduced by the income-based reduction, never below zero; otherwise $0. The disability subtraction that can be taken instead is out of scope.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerAgeDeductionAllowed">
  <Name>Age deduction the primary filer qualifies for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939;
        otherwise, if 65 or older, $12,000 reduced by the income-based reduction, never below zero;
        otherwise $0. The disability subtraction that can be taken instead is out of scope.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerBornOnOrBefore1939"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerQualifiesForIncomeBasedAgeDeduction"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <GreaterOf>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum"/>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionReduction"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
          </GreaterOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction the spouse qualifies for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5), for the spouse on a joint return, with the same rule as the primary filer: $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older, $12,000 reduced by the return's income-based reduction; otherwise $0. Assumption, from the Code's text: the deduction is "for individuals", and on a joint return "the taxpayer's adjusted federal adjusted gross income" is the joint AFAGI, so each spouse's $12,000 is reduced by the same excess over $75,000. If Virginia Tax's Age Deduction Worksheet instead reduces the couple's combined $24,000 once, this is the fact to change.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseAgeDeductionAllowed">
  <Name>Age deduction the spouse qualifies for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5), for the spouse on a joint return, with the same rule as
        the primary filer: $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older,
        $12,000 reduced by the return's income-based reduction; otherwise $0. Assumption, from the
        Code's text: the deduction is "for individuals", and on a joint return "the taxpayer's
        adjusted federal adjusted gross income" is the joint AFAGI, so each spouse's $12,000 is
        reduced by the same excess over $75,000. If Virginia Tax's Age Deduction Worksheet instead
        reduces the couple's combined $24,000 once, this is the fact to change.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseBornOnOrBefore1939"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaSpouseQualifiesForIncomeBasedAgeDeduction"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <GreaterOf>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum"/>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionReduction"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
          </GreaterOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction the return qualifies for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): the primary filer's deduction plus, on a joint return, the spouse's. Line 4 claims this unless the return claims a low-income credit instead (/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 4 and the Age Deduction Worksheet.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed">
  <Name>Age deduction the return qualifies for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): the primary filer's deduction plus, on a joint return,
        the spouse's. Line 4 claims this unless the return claims a low-income credit instead
        (/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 4 and the Age Deduction
        Worksheet.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaSpouseAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 4, age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(5): a return on which the filer or the spouse claims the age deduction cannot claim the Credit for Low-Income Individuals or either Virginia Earned Income Credit. The age deduction the return qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims one of those credits instead.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 4, age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(5): a return on which the filer or the spouse claims the age
        deduction cannot claim the Credit for Low-Income Individuals or either Virginia Earned Income
        Credit. The age deduction the return qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims one of those

  <Derived>

      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed"/>

  </Derived>

facts.name: Served in, or received retirement pay from, the U.S. Armed Forces in 2024
facts.description: Asked, as the gate to the two military questions. Neither basic pay nor military retirement is identifiable on the forms the federal return exports: a W-2 from the military reports box 1, not basic pay, and the federal 1099-R question "is this from a military retirement plan" is not exported to states.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome">
  <Name>Served in, or received retirement pay from, the U.S. Armed Forces in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Asked, as the gate to the two military questions. Neither basic pay nor military
        retirement is identifiable on the forms the federal return exports: a W-2 from the military
        reports box 1, not basic pay, and the federal 1099-R question "is this from a military
        retirement plan" is not exported to states.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Boolean/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

facts.name: On extended active duty for more than 90 consecutive days in 2024
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15). Asked; primary filer only.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaHasMilitaryBasicPay">
  <Name>On extended active duty for more than 90 consecutive days in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15). Asked; primary filer only.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Boolean/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military basic pay received in 2024
facts.description: Basic pay only, from the filer's Leave and Earnings Statements; not allowances, bonuses or special pays, which W-2 box 1 also includes.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay">
  <Name>Military basic pay received in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Basic pay only, from the filer's Leave and Earnings Statements; not allowances,
        bonuses or special pays, which W-2 box 1 also includes.</Description>

  </Writable>
  <Placeholder>

  </Placeholder>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction the filer qualifies for (Schedule ADJ code 38)
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): all basic pay up to $15,000; above that, $15,000 reduced dollar for dollar by the pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. Limited to what federal AGI includes, here W-2 wages. The cap is the household's /wages (exported to MeF): the federal per-filer figures (/primaryFilerWages, /formW2s/*/filer, /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) are not exported to states, so the primary filer's own wages cannot be read here; on a joint return the cap is therefore loose by the spouse's wages. Claimed on Line 7 only if the return does not claim a low-income credit (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtractionAllowed">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction the filer qualifies for (Schedule ADJ code 38)</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): all basic pay up to $15,000; above that, $15,000
        reduced dollar for dollar by the pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. Limited to
        what federal AGI includes, here W-2 wages. The cap is the household's /wages (exported to
        MeF): the federal per-filer figures (/primaryFilerWages, /formW2s/*/filer,
        /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) are not exported to states, so the primary filer's own
        wages cannot be read here; on a joint return the cap is therefore loose by the spouse's
        wages. Claimed on Line 7 only if the return does not claim a low-income credit (Va. Code
        § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryBasicPay"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum"/>
            </Right>
          </LessThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayPhasedOut"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction after the phase-out
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): $15,000 reduced $1 for each $1 of basic pay over $15,000, never below zero. Only read when the basic pay is over $15,000.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayPhasedOut">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction after the phase-out</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): $15,000 reduced $1 for each $1 of basic pay over
        $15,000, never below zero. Only read when the basic pay is over $15,000.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Subtract>
            <Minuend>
              <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            </Minuend>
            <Subtrahends>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum"/>
            </Subtrahends>
          </Subtract>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ code 38, military basic pay subtraction, as claimed
facts.description: The subtraction the filer qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims a low-income credit instead (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtraction">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ code 38, military basic pay subtraction, as claimed</Name>
  <Description>The subtraction the filer qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims a low-income
        credit instead (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtractionAllowed"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Received military retirement pay or Survivor Benefit Plan payments in 2024
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c) and (d). Asked; primary filer only.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaHasMilitaryRetirement">
  <Name>Received military retirement pay or Survivor Benefit Plan payments in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c) and (d). Asked; primary filer only.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Boolean/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military benefits received in 2024

facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryRetirementIncome">
  <Name>Military benefits received in 2024</Name>
  <Description>The taxable amount (1099-R box 2a) of military retirement pay, Survivor Benefit
        Plan payments and other military benefits paid to a surviving spouse.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Dollar/>
  </Writable>
  <Placeholder>
    <Dollar>0</Dollar>
  </Placeholder>
</Fact>

facts.name: Taxable amount on every 1099-R of the return
facts.description: The sum of box 2a across the 1099-Rs on the federal return (/form1099Rs/*/taxableAmount, exported to MeF in each 1099-R). Military benefits are retirement income, so a military benefits subtraction cannot exceed this.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaForm1099RTaxableAmounts">
  <Name>Taxable amount on every 1099-R of the return</Name>
  <Description>The sum of box 2a across the 1099-Rs on the federal return
        (/form1099Rs/*/taxableAmount, exported to MeF in each 1099-R). Military benefits are
        retirement income, so a military benefits subtraction cannot exceed this.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <CollectionSum>
      <Dependency module="form1099Rs" path="/form1099Rs/*/taxableAmount"/>
    </CollectionSum>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ code 60, military benefits subtraction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c): up to $30,000 for taxable year 2024, at any age, and never more than the taxable 1099-R income the federal return reports (the subtraction is of an amount "included therein", in federal AGI). It does not bar the low-income credits (§ 58.1-339.8(D) does not list it).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsSubtraction">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ code 60, military benefits subtraction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c): up to $30,000 for taxable year 2024, at any age, and
        never more than the taxable 1099-R income the federal return reports (the subtraction is of an
        amount "included therein", in federal AGI). It does not bar the low-income credits
        (§ 58.1-339.8(D) does not list it).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryRetirement"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryRetirementIncome"/>
            <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsMaximum"/>
            <Dependency path="/vaForm1099RTaxableAmounts"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ code 37, unemployment benefits subtraction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02: unemployment compensation included in federal AGI is subtracted in full (2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 37). Direct File puts each 1099-G's box 1 into AGI net of what was repaid in the year, and exports both figures to states (/form1099Gs/*/amount, /form1099Gs/*/amountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear), so the subtraction is their difference, rounded the way the federal /unemploymentCompensation is. No question is asked.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaUnemploymentCompensationSubtraction">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ code 37, unemployment benefits subtraction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02: unemployment compensation included in federal AGI is
        subtracted in full (2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 37). Direct File
        puts each 1099-G's box 1 into AGI net of what was repaid in the year, and exports both figures
        to states (/form1099Gs/*/amount, /form1099Gs/*/amountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear), so the
        subtraction is their difference, rounded the way the federal /unemploymentCompensation is. No
        question is asked.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <CollectionSum>
            <Dependency module="unemployment" path="/form1099Gs/*/amount"/>
          </CollectionSum>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <CollectionSum>
            <Dependency module="unemployment" path="/form1099Gs/*/amountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear"/>
          </CollectionSum>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 7, subtractions from Schedule ADJ
facts.description: Schedule ADJ Line 7: unemployment benefits (code 37), military basic pay (code 38) as claimed, and military benefits (code 60). The other Schedule ADJ subtractions are out of scope and taken as $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaScheduleAdjSubtractions">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 7, subtractions from Schedule ADJ</Name>
  <Description>Schedule ADJ Line 7: unemployment benefits (code 37), military basic pay (code 38)
        as claimed, and military benefits (code 60). The other Schedule ADJ subtractions are out of
        scope and taken as $0.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaUnemploymentCompensationSubtraction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtraction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsSubtraction"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Subtractions the low-income credits do not affect
facts.description: Line 5 (Social Security), and on Line 7 the unemployment and military benefits subtractions. The age deduction and the military basic pay subtraction are the two that a low-income credit replaces.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSubtractionsEitherWay">
  <Name>Subtractions the low-income credits do not affect</Name>
  <Description>Line 5 (Social Security), and on Line 7 the unemployment and military benefits
        subtractions. The age deduction and the military basic pay subtraction are the two that a
        low-income credit replaces.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaTaxableSocialSecurityBenefits"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaUnemploymentCompensationSubtraction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsSubtraction"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 8 if the return keeps the age deduction and military basic pay subtraction
facts.description: Lines 4 + 5 + 6 + 7 with Line 4 and code 38 as the filers qualify for them. Line 6 (state income tax refund, Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(5)) is out of scope and taken as $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalSubtractions">
  <Name>Line 8 if the return keeps the age deduction and military basic pay subtraction</Name>
  <Description>Lines 4 + 5 + 6 + 7 with Line 4 and code 38 as the filers qualify for them. Line 6
        (state income tax refund, Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(5)) is out of scope and taken as $0.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaSubtractionsEitherWay"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtractionAllowed"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 8 if the return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: Lines 5 + 7 with no age deduction and no military basic pay subtraction (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2) and (5)).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithCreditTotalSubtractions">
  <Name>Line 8 if the return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>Lines 5 + 7 with no age deduction and no military basic pay subtraction (Va. Code
        § 58.1-339.8(D)(2) and (5)).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Dependency path="/vaSubtractionsEitherWay"/>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 9 if the return keeps the age deduction and military basic pay subtraction
facts.description: Line 1 minus Line 8, with Line 4 and code 38 as the filers qualify for them.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditAdjustedGrossIncome">
  <Name>Line 9 if the return keeps the age deduction and military basic pay subtraction</Name>
  <Description>Line 1 minus Line 8, with Line 4 and code 38 as the filers qualify for them.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Subtract>
      <Minuend>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
      </Minuend>
      <Subtrahends>
        <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalSubtractions"/>
      </Subtrahends>
    </Subtract>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 9 if the return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: Line 1 minus Line 8 with no age deduction and no military basic pay subtraction (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2) and (5)). This is also the family VAGI of Schedule ADJ Line 10.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithCreditAdjustedGrossIncome">
  <Name>Line 9 if the return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>Line 1 minus Line 8 with no age deduction and no military basic pay subtraction
        (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2) and (5)). This is also the family VAGI of Schedule ADJ Line 10.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Subtract>
      <Minuend>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
      </Minuend>
      <Subtrahends>
        <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTotalSubtractions"/>
      </Subtrahends>
    </Subtract>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 8, total subtractions
facts.description: Lines 4 + 5 + 6 + 7, as claimed: the with-credit or the without-credit figure, whichever way the return files, so that Line 9 is always Line 1 minus this.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaTotalSubtractions">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 8, total subtractions</Name>
  <Description>Lines 4 + 5 + 6 + 7, as claimed: the with-credit or the without-credit figure,

  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTotalSubtractions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalSubtractions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 9, Virginia adjusted gross income
facts.description: Line 3 minus Line 8. Va. Code § 58.1-322 defines Virginia taxable income by reference to federal adjusted gross income with the Chapter 3 modifications.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAdjustedGrossIncome">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 9, Virginia adjusted gross income</Name>
  <Description>Line 3 minus Line 8. Va. Code § 58.1-322 defines Virginia taxable income by
        reference to federal adjusted gross income with the Chapter 3 modifications.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia filing threshold for this return
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaFilingThreshold">
  <Name>Virginia filing threshold for this return</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-321(A).</Description>

    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaFilingThresholdMarried"/>

      </Case>

facts.name: Below the filing threshold, keeping the age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-321(A); 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 9: if Line 9 is less than the amount for your filing status, your Virginia income tax is $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditIsBelowFilingThreshold">

      <Left>
        <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Dependency path="/vaFilingThreshold"/>
      </Right>
    </LessThan>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Below the filing threshold, claiming a low-income credit
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-321(A); 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 9: if Line 9 is less than the amount for your filing status, your Virginia income tax is $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithCreditIsBelowFilingThreshold">
  <Name>Below the filing threshold, claiming a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-321(A); 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 9: if Line 9 is less

facts.name: City or county the filer lived in on January 1, 2025
facts.description: Form 760 header, "Locality Code"; 2024 instructions page 14: "the locality in which you lived on January 1, 2025 ... Local school funding is allocated based in part on this information." Asked and confirmed by the filer: the federal address gives a city name and a ZIP, but a ZIP can straddle localities and the date is the day after the tax year. When the ZIP lies in one locality, website-static/js/virginia-locality.js fills this in from it, and the filer confirms it.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaLocality">
  <Name>City or county the filer lived in on January 1, 2025</Name>
  <Description>Form 760 header, "Locality Code"; 2024 instructions page 14: "the locality in which you
        lived on January 1, 2025 ... Local school funding is allocated based in part on this
        information." Asked and confirmed by the filer: the federal address gives a city name and a
        ZIP, but a ZIP can straddle localities and the date is the day after the tax year. When the
        ZIP lies in one locality, website-static/js/virginia-locality.js fills this in from it, and
        the filer confirms it.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Enum optionsPath="/vaLocalityOptions"/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

Richmond City is in the Central Virginia region.
