facts.name: This W-2's box 15 names Virginia
facts.description: Direct File derives each W-2's MeF state code (/formW2s/*/xmlStateCd, the StateAbbreviationCd of the W-2 in the Form 1040 XML a state receives) from the residence answer whenever box 15 is filled in, and knocks a return out when a W-2 is from another state (/flowKnockoutBox15IncomeFromDifferentState); the box 15 answer itself (/formW2s/*/state) is not exported. So on a Virginia resident return the code is "VA" exactly when box 15 is filled in, and that is the test here: a resident return and a state code present. Written as a completeness test rather than a comparison with "VA" because the workbench sandbox stands each federal fact in by type and has no per-form string; the two tests agree on every return this module can see, and the ScalaTest asserts the stricter one.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/formW2s/*/vaStateIsVirginia">
  <Name>This W-2's box 15 names Virginia</Name>
  <Description>Direct File derives each W-2's MeF state code (/formW2s/*/xmlStateCd, the
        StateAbbreviationCd of the W-2 in the Form 1040 XML a state receives) from the residence
        answer whenever box 15 is filled in, and knocks a return out when a W-2 is from another state
        (/flowKnockoutBox15IncomeFromDifferentState); the box 15 answer itself (/formW2s/*/state) is
        not exported. So on a Virginia resident return the code is "VA" exactly when box 15 is
        filled in, and that is the test here: a resident return and a state code present. Written
        as a completeness test rather than a comparison with "VA" because the workbench sandbox stands
        each federal fact in by type and has no per-form string; the two tests agree on every return
        this module can see, and the ScalaTest asserts the stricter one.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsResident"/>
      <IsComplete>
        <Dependency module="formW2s" path="../xmlStateCd"/>
      </IsComplete>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: This W-2's Virginia income tax withheld
facts.description: Box 17 (/formW2s/*/stateWithholding, exported to MeF in each W-2) when box 15 names Virginia; otherwise $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/formW2s/*/vaWithholding">
  <Name>This W-2's Virginia income tax withheld</Name>
  <Description>Box 17 (/formW2s/*/stateWithholding, exported to MeF in each W-2) when box 15 names
        Virginia; otherwise $0.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="../vaStateIsVirginia"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="formW2s" path="../stateWithholding"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 19a, Virginia income tax withheld
facts.description: The sum of box 17 across the W-2s on the federal return whose box 15 names Virginia. The employer files the same W-2 with Virginia. Line 19b (the spouse's share on a joint return) is folded in here: which filer a W-2 belongs to (/formW2s/*/filer, /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) is not exported to states, so the split cannot be made from the export; a state would match each W-2's employee TIN (/formW2s/*/usedTin, exported) against the filers' TINs instead. Line 19 (19a + 19b) is unchanged by the split.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithholding">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 19a, Virginia income tax withheld</Name>
  <Description>The sum of box 17 across the W-2s on the federal return whose box 15 names
        Virginia. The employer files the same W-2 with Virginia. Line 19b (the spouse's share on a
        joint return) is folded in here: which filer a W-2 belongs to (/formW2s/*/filer,
        /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) is not exported to states, so the split cannot be made
        from the export; a state would match each W-2's employee TIN (/formW2s/*/usedTin, exported)
        against the filers' TINs instead. Line 19 (19a + 19b) is unchanged by the split.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <CollectionSum>
      <Dependency path="/formW2s/*/vaWithholding"/>
    </CollectionSum>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 33, consumer's use tax
facts.description: The untaxed purchases times the rate for the filer's locality (/vaUseTaxRate in the virginiaLocalities module), rounded to the dollar; $0 when the filer had no untaxed purchases.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaUseTax">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 33, consumer's use tax</Name>
  <Description>The untaxed purchases times the rate for the filer's locality
        (/vaUseTaxRate in the virginiaLocalities module), rounded to the dollar; $0 when the filer had
        no untaxed purchases.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaHasUntaxedPurchases"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Round>
            <Multiply>
              <Dependency module="virginiaLocalities" path="/vaUseTaxRate"/>
              <Dependency path="/vaUntaxedPurchases"/>
            </Multiply>
          </Round>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Tax from the rate schedule, keeping the age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-320, taxable years from 1990: 2% of income not exceeding $3,000; 3% of income over $3,000 to $5,000; 5% of income over $5,000 to $17,000; 5.75% of income over $17,000. Written as the cumulative schedule the 2024 Form 760 instructions print: $60 at $3,000, $120 at $5,000, $720 at $17,000 (the /vaRateSchedule… figures). Rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxFromRateSchedule">
  <Name>Tax from the rate schedule, keeping the age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-320, taxable years from 1990: 2% of income not exceeding
        $3,000; 3% of income over $3,000 to $5,000; 5% of income over $5,000 to $17,000; 5.75% of
        income over $17,000. Written as the cumulative schedule the 2024 Form 760 instructions
        print: $60 at $3,000, $120 at $5,000, $720 at $17,000 (the /vaRateSchedule… figures).
        Rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket1Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Multiply>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate1"/>
              <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
            </Multiply>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket2Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket1Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate2"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket1Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket3Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket2Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate3"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket2Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket3Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate4"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket3Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>
